comment: Hand-crafted: the Doctor query of gh dojo doctor. The data shape follows the GraphQL schema (viewer, repository); X-OAuth-Scopes is the header GitHub sends for classic tokens, which recording does not keep. Organization acme enforces SAML SSO the token is not authorized for: repo0 is null with FORBIDDEN and extensions.saml_failure (message and shape as in internal/board/testdata/graphql/org_board_saml.json).

errors.message: Resource protected by organization SAML enforcement. You must grant your OAuth token access to this organization.
